changeSet.author: eduar.troyano
changeSet.comment: Crea la tabla enrollments: inscripción de un estudiante a una ruta, con su perfil y objetivo (brief: Inscripción). La columna profile_embedding es provisional (D-01). Incluye secuencia propia, tabla de auditoría enrollments_audit y el trigger enrollments_audit_trg.

createTable.remarks: Student enrollment in a learning path, with profile and personal objective

column.name: profile_description
column.remarks: Free-text description of the student current knowledge

column.name: profile_embedding
column.remarks: Embedding of the student profile. Dimension is provisional (pending decision D-01)

column.name: personal_objective
column.remarks: Personal learning objective confirmed by the student

column.name: status
column.remarks: Enrollment status: enrolled, in_progress, completed, abandoned

column.name: active
column.remarks: Logical state: false means deactivated (rows are never deleted)

changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE enrollments ADD CONSTRAINT enrollments_status_ck CHECK (status IN ('enrolled', 'in_progress', 'completed', 'abandoned'))

column.name: audit_id
column.remarks: Primary key of the audit row

column.name: record_id
column.remarks: Id of the audited row in enrollments

column.name: db_user
column.remarks: Database user that made the change

column.name: app_user_id
column.remarks: Application user that made the change (smartmentor.current_user_id)

changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE enrollments_audit ADD CONSTRAINT enrollments_audit_operation_ck CHECK (operation IN ('INSERT', 'UPDATE', 'DELETE'))
CREATE TRIGGER enrollments_audit_trg AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OR DELETE ON enrollments FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit_row_change()

rollback.sql: DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS enrollments_audit_trg ON enrollments
